identity:
nowyouseeme.mp3

Footage from what looks like a lab with a person trapped in a clear glass box.  The scientist drones on 'Experiment 65: Escape from a sealed enclosure'.  When the scientist says 'Begin' the subject inside the glass enclosure gets a very focused look on their face.  It gets more strenous for ten seconds and then the subject starts to take a step directly into the glass, vanishing before they bump into it.  Almost instantaneosly reappearing about six feet outside of the enclosure.

entries.developer_comments: ~ Description of spell 'To Shield the Spirit from Assault'
identity: The first principle of defending your spirit is to make sure it is in proper order so there is no foothold an assault can take advantage of.  While in effect, your soul is protected against attack.  <color_red>Too much pain</color> will disrupt your concentration.
